title: Agents read policy vehicles only for policies they produce (S5 gate medium)
story: As a carrier I want an agent to see policy vehicles only for policies that agent produces so that staff accounts cannot enumerate policy numbers
acceptance: For the agent role, GET /intake/sessions/{id}/policy-vehicles returns vehicles only when the policy is produced by that agent (reuse the existing producer/ownership rule, e.g. producesPolicy), otherwise the same uniform 404 as for claimants
CSR behaviour unchanged; claimant holder rule from S5-WFL-01 unchanged; tests cover agent-producer, agent-non-producer, unknown policy
node --test tests/unit/intake/ passes; tests/e2e and tests/security show no new failures; do not edit tests/security
brief: Finding from the S5-WFL-01 security gate: assertAccess lets an agent read any session it started without a holder or producer check, so a non-empty array confirms a policy exists. Find the agent-producer rule already used in intake (grep producesPolicy / agent ownership in src/modules/intake and src/modules/coverage).

verdicts.reason: Code is correct and e2e/security clean, but criterion 3 (tests/unit/intake passes) fails: policy-vehicles.test.js 'agent who owns the session...' and policy-vehicles-holder.test.js 'csr and agent keep current behaviour' encode superseded behavior and must be updated (ticket paths need widening)

Round 2: code correct, but node --test tests/unit/intake/*.test.js still fails 2/71 (policy-vehicles.test.js 'agent who owns the session...' and policy-vehicles-holder.test.js 'csr and agent keep current behaviour') encode superseded behavior; criterion 3 unmet, ticket paths must be widened to those test files
Closed by orchestrator: agent-producer rule verified inside the S5-WFL-04 review (its outdated tests were outside S5-WFL-03's paths, an orchestrator scoping error)
